findings: The four repository source Questions all ask for the Spring Bean/singleton circular-dependency mechanism; the current type audit correctly treats the target as a mechanism answer rather than a fabricated project scenario.

The frozen primary-source packet binds the supported singleton early-exposure sequence, the three singleton-registry structures, the early proxy-reference hook, constructor-cycle failure, and policy/scope limits.

The candidate explains instantiate -> early-reference factory -> dependency population -> initialization -> final singleton publication and treats '三级缓存' as interview shorthand rather than a formal guarantee that all three structures are ordinary caches.

The candidate preserves important limits: constructor-to-constructor cycles are not solved by this mechanism, prototype/arbitrary graphs are not generalized, and Spring Boot product defaults are kept separate from Spring Framework core mechanics.
